title: MarkdStage — Create slides with AI, refine, present, and share
description: An open-source tool for drafting slides with AI and refining text and diagrams directly. Manage Markdown and themes separately, inspect layout, present, and export PDF or editable PowerPoint.
heroDescription: Ask AI to draft or revise slides, then refine text and diagrams yourself. Manage content in Markdown and appearance with themes, from layout review through presentation and PDF or editable PowerPoint export.
heroAlt: An architecture slide rendered in MarkdStage's light theme, connecting a browser to an API and a database.
heroNote: You can also edit Markdown directly and present without AI.

needs.title: Separate content from appearance
needs.body: Edit text in Markdown and adjust colors and typography through themes. Keep the theme while revising the content.

needs.title: Make small changes directly
needs.body: Refine an AI draft's wording as text and adjust Architecture diagram positions visually. You do not have to send every small change back through AI.

needs.title: Check fit and appearance
needs.body: Ask AI to check fit. It uses layout diagnostics to find clipping and reviews images of selected pages to narrow down areas that need revision.

examplesDescription: Switch between examples to view the rendered slides and their Markdown source. You can also download the example Markdown files.
markdownAlt: A dark slide with a heading, three bullet points, and syntax-highlighted JavaScript.
architectureAlt: An architecture diagram connecting a browser, API, and database, with positions, icons, and connectors defined in Architecture DSL.
markdownDescription: Write text, bullet lists, and code blocks in Markdown, with syntax highlighting for code. Use Mermaid for automatic, relationship-driven diagram layout; its colors can also follow the theme.
architectureDescription: Create architecture diagrams with JSON-based Architecture DSL inside Markdown. Specify positions, sizes, groups, icons, and connectors when you want to compose a diagram for the slide.
editorDescription: Refine nodes and connectors directly, including in Architecture DSL diagrams drafted by AI. Saving in the Architecture Editor writes the draft changes back to Markdown. Visual editing is available in Canvas and through the CLI's preview --watch.
editorAlt: The Azure hub-spoke diagram in Architecture Editor, with Hub VNet selected and its position, size, and style available for editing.
workflowTitle: From draft to presentation and sharing

steps.title: Draft with AI
steps.body: Provide source material or notes, an audience, and a presentation length. Use Canvas or the CLI with an Agent Skill to draft Markdown with guidance for the format and themes.

steps.title: Refine directly and inspect
steps.body: Edit text in Markdown and Architecture positions in the editor. Ask AI to check fit using diagnostics and images of selected pages to identify areas needing revision. You can also review the appearance yourself in the preview.
steps.detail: Text editing · Diagram placement · Layout diagnostics

steps.title: Present and share
steps.body: Keep speaker notes in front of you while displaying slides on another screen. Review every page of the final output before sharing a PDF or PowerPoint file to suit the recipient's needs.

shareDescription: Recipients do not need MarkdStage. Give them a file they can view or edit in the tools they already use.
pdfDescription: Distribute fixed 16:9 slides that recipients can open in a PDF viewer.
pptxDescription: Hand over supported text, tables, code, and Architecture diagrams as editable elements. This is hybrid output: unsupported representations use fallback images. PowerPoint edits do not round-trip to Markdown.
startDescription: Use the CLI and an Agent Skill with Claude Code or Codex, or Canvas with the GitHub Copilot App. Direct editing without AI and native presentation apps remain available.
cliDescription: Ask Claude Code or Codex to create, review, and export slides. The Skill provides MarkdStage format and command guidance; the GitHub Copilot App is not required.
cliRequirements: Requires Node.js 24 or later and Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome, or Chromium.
cliInstallDescription: Install the CLI, then register the Skill for your AI tool in the folder where you will create the deck. This example uses Claude Code.
cliAlternative: For Codex, replace the Skill registration line with the following. You do not need both.
cliAuthorDescription: Open that folder in Claude Code or Codex and provide source material or notes with your request. You do not need an existing slides.md.
authorPrompt: Use the markdstage skill to create five slides for a technical audience from these notes in slides.md. Use the dark theme, preview the deck, and check the layout.
refinePrompt: Keep the theme and shorten only the explanation on slide 2.
cliPreviewDescription: Edit Markdown directly and refresh the preview on save. Use the pencil control to adjust Architecture positions, or Advanced edit for detailed editing and saving.
cliInspectDescription: Ask the same AI to check fit. It follows the Skill's diagnostic workflow, so you do not need to name the commands.
inspectPrompt: Check whether the content fits on the slides. Identify any clipping and review images of the pages that need a closer look.
cliOutputTitle: How diagnostics work, and presentation/export commands
cliCheckDescription: The following diagnostic commands are intended primarily for AI. It uses validate for structure, themes, and DSL, then inspect for fixed 16:9 clipping. The AI receives structured results and uses capture --pages for images of pages that need visual review.
cliDeliveryDescription: Ask AI to present or export, or run the following commands yourself.
cliNext: Select “Start presentation” in the presenter view opened by present to launch the audience window. Review every page of the final output before distribution.
directDescription: Download an example Markdown file, or create one in a text editor and save it as slides.md. Open it with CLI preview / present or Canvas's More controls > Open Markdown. No Skill registration is needed; preview without --watch is read-only.
desktopDescription: A Windows app that opens Markdown files and displays slides. View the current slide, next slide, and speaker notes while presenting. The GitHub Copilot App is not required.
desktopDetail: Portable builds · x64 / ARM64 · Checksums included
canvasDescription: Display slides in the GitHub Copilot App canvas. Ask Copilot to create Markdown or revise diagrams, or open Markdown files directly to display them.
canvasPrompt: Install MarkdStage at user scope from the following GitHub repository folder.
canvasWarning: The Extension runs local code. Review its contents before installing and use a trusted release.
canvasNext: After installation, provide source material or notes and ask Copilot to create a deck.
canvasAuthorPrompt: Create five slides for a technical audience from these notes. Save them as slides.md with the dark theme and display them in MarkdStage Canvas.
canvasReview: Ask Copilot to check whether the content fits on the slides. Copilot uses inspect_layout and images of selected pages for the review. Use More controls > Output preview when checking the appearance yourself.
macNote: is available as a separate project. It is developed, released, and supported outside this repository.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
copyUnavailable: Clipboard is unavailable. Select the text and copy it manually.
